task_reconstruction.official_task: Model information circulation, filter news, and predict network size to about 2050.

section_map.summary: Summary names four models and gives the New York forecast.
Four compartments defined, with the super-spreader added to SIR.
Fuzzy news filter scored on four given cases.
Strengths and weaknesses paired per model.

contributions.summary: A super-spreader compartment that recovers classical SIR at stated parameter values.
Separate saturation and strengthening functions for interest decay.

dependency_graph.handoff: node count and node degree as the quantities to predict
the audience awareness score as inherent value

assumptions.summary: The network is treated as the same worldwide.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: California, Texas and New York chosen for data availability.
Inputs normalized by min-max before the network.

models.summary: Four-compartment epidemic model with a super-spreader.
Back-propagation forecast of node count and degree.

verification.summary: Four given cases scored and ranked.
New York in the fifth period held out of training.

results_trace.summary: Node count error 15.32 percent, node degree error 20.58 percent.
Fit reported as R of 0.99 and, in the table, at most 0.91.

writing_logic.summary: Each task is restated as a sentence about what the paper must produce.
The parameter values that recover the borrowed model are stated.
Each model gets its strength and its weakness in the same row.

language_observations.summary: Results are stated as the shape of a curve.
A quantity is defined by a contrast the reader already knows.
Conclusions are numbered, one curve each.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 2 plots the four densities and the laws are read off it.
Figure 9 overlays three beta values to show only the timing changes.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The held-out error table makes the reliability claim checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Put the neighbor densities back into the derivatives and refit.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: A fourth compartment with a stated degeneracy to SIR.
Three borrowed factors with printed weights.
State selection justified, and a misaligned appendix table kept.
Held-out relative errors reported per quantity.
One parameter moved at a time by a stated percent.
Every model named with its abbreviation first.
Prose transitions and printed derivatives disagree. Both recorded.
An assumption denies the mechanism a later section uses.

unresolved_questions: The transition rules depend on contact with neighbors. The printed derivatives have no neighbor term. Both kept.
Assumption 3 says social strengthening is ignored. The PIINI model is built on it. Both kept.
The fit is reported as R of 0.99 and the hidden-node table peaks at 0.91. Both kept.
